messages.subject: Mplus: How to apply multinomial logistic regression to each of the boootsrap LCGA sample?
messages.subject_clean: Mplus: How to apply multinomial logistic regression to each of the boootsrap LCGA sample?
messages.body_plain:
Dear Michael and Group,

Thank you for your time,

I am relatively new to Mplus and have just begun with R (familiar with STATA, SPSS etc)
I have created latent class growth analasis (LCGA) 5-class solution, with a multinomial logistic model for covariates compared to base.

I am performing MonteCarlo bootstrap of the LCGA model and compared to actual using CHI-square fit statistics.

Problem: I am attempting to run a multinomial regression for EACH of the generated bootstrap LCGA replications, then compare these (simulated) regression results against the original regression output, thus gaining a form of validation for the regression as in Ferro, 2013 (also see attached table from Ferro).

"Latent class growth modeling and multinomial logistic regression was applied to each bootstrap sample and the mean estimate for each parameter was reported."

I have been able to generate files of the boostrap data (using REPSAVE), but I cannot finad a way to attach the regression covariates to each bootstrap replication, or how to combine the regression results as in the attached table.

Wold you please offer some pointers on how this could be achieved in MplusAutomation. I have attached my Mplus .inp files for further model clarification.

Thanks again,

Aron

1.    Ferro MA, Speechley KN. Stability of latent classes in group-based trajectory modeling of depressive symptoms in mothers of children with epilepsy: an internal validation study using a bootstrapping procedure. Soc Psychiatry Psychiatr Epidemiol 2013;48:1077-86.
